header.description: FMM3D's Helmholtz direct sum, the potential and gradient of e^{ik|x-y|}/(4 pi |x-y|) (draft CONVENTIONS §3.15 item 1, docs/helmholtz/conventions-3.15-draft.md), for real, complex and imaginary k and real and complex charges (Helmholtz CH1.4)
header.convention: the draft §3.15 of CH1.4 (not yet in docs/CONVENTIONS.md: CH1.1)
header.routine: h3ddirectcg (FMM3D's direct sum: charges, potential and gradient)
header.eps: none: a direct evaluation (hfmm3d_s_c_g at eps 1e-12 only in two_point)

build.variant: variant default: make lib FAST_KER=OFF (OpenMP on: FMM3D's default)

header.reference: every value checked against the draft's kernel summed in mpmath 1.4.1 at 30 digits, to 1e-13 (relative l2 per case and quantity, and per point relative to its sum of term magnitudes)
header.format: decimal strings, 17 significant digits of FMM3D's doubles; complex values as [re, im]; a gradient as [re x, im x, re y, im y, re z, im z]; the values at the sources (self term dropped) in source order, then at the targets; the factor 1/(4 pi) included

identified: factor 1/(4π), e^{+ikr}, gradient in the target, charge q
